name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Afroditi Latinopoulou
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Afroditi Latinopoulou, a Member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Greek prosecutors asked for this because they want to charge her with forgery, using forged documents and electoral fraud. They say she founded a political party using fake signatures and got public money for it. Lifting her protection means the Greek case against her can now go ahead.

- Greek prosecutors can now charge and prosecute Latinopoulou over the alleged fake party signatures.
- It affects Latinopoulou, who loses her protection from prosecution in this case.
- Parliament's President will send the decision to the Greek authorities and to her.
